name: znetwork_alloc_free_player_color_index
description: zNetwork::AllocFreePlayerColorIndex reserves and returns the first unused player color index from the current session's player range.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zNetwork DirectPlay/session source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48b940 validates scanning color indexes from 1 through current session maxPlayers, setting g_zNetwork_PlayerColorInUseFlags[index] for the first zero entry, returning that index, and returning zero for no available slot or zero maxPlayers.
The native zNetwork color allocation smoke verifies first-free allocation, full-list zero return, and zero-max-player zero return without reserving a color.
